0x000800.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008F9.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A5A.en: 「Well now...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B23.en: 「Ugh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B5E.en: 「Like hell I lose here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000BB2.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I have no choice but to bail...」

0x000C26.en: 「Agh! Guess I've got to fall back!!」

0x000C9C.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D03.en: 「This is it for me... The rest is yours.」

0x000DAF.en: 「No good, we took too much... I'm retreating!」

0x000DFC.en: 「Well, this is a fix. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E3A.en: 「Eek! The rest is up to you, please!」

0x000E81.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F2C.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010D5.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00111C.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001151.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x00120E.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x00123D.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a lot to learn...!」

0x00128B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001346.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001375.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013B3.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013E2.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x00146D.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015D3.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it with style...」

0x0019A5.en: 「Yes. A hostile entity whose appearance was confirmed@ even during the <Shura Rebellion>.」

0x0019FD.en: 「The LTR Organization calls them Yokijin,@ said to be the enemies of the <Chokijin>...@ though they're the stuff of ghosts and monsters.」

0x001A9B.en: 「Hmph, one after another...@ So many incidents in so short a span.@ This can no longer be dismissed as mere coincidence.」

0x001B86.en: 「I'm tempted to think so... But bringing the Demon matter@ up to me means you consider it highly likely@ they'll appear again, doesn't it?」

0x001C40.en: 「Yes.@ They may become a new threat to us.」

0x001C96.en: 「That's what the 'GS' is for.@ How is the Grand Christmas coming along?」

0x001D01.en: 「At present, Special Aide Steinbeck@ is directing operations personally on Aidoneus Island.」

0x001D7E.en: 「Weapon trials and deployment are on schedule.@ Force organization will be complete shortly.」

0x001DEF.en: 「The members seem to have various... histories?」

0x001E2C.en: 「A military organization separate from the Federation Army...@　that's the concept behind the 'GS.' But these are the times we live in...」

0x001EBC.en: 「Gathering people with zero ties to army or DC@ is nearly impossible. Taking the good with the@ bad is the only way to assemble such talent.」

0x001F73.en: 「Mr. President...@ As the man who planned Mission Halper,@ I believe you understand.」

0x00200A.en: 「Have no concern.@ The 'GS' is staffed with those who will@ carry out their orders faithfully.」

0x0020BC.en: 「...As you note, several members do have@ blemishes on their records, but...」

0x002124.en: 「Special Aide Steinbeck and I ran the selection.@ We chose no one who'd tarnish a presidential@ unit's name, or scheme to topple the regime.」

0x002202.en: 「...You can keep them on a tight rein?」

0x002233.en: 「Of course.@ Otherwise, our own standing as your@ special aides would be in jeopardy as well.」

0x0022BA.en: 「Someone is sure to dig into the@　GS members' backgrounds. I cannot have the Assembly@　tripping us up with a scandal now.」

0x002380.en: 「The money trail can be kept quiet, given the crisis.@ But once the GS reveals its full form,@ the conservatives and military will push back.」

0x002440.en: 「In which case, the Tzentr Project makes@ a prime target. Anticipate the opposition's inquiries@ and take measures now.」

0x0024DF.en: 「Understood.@ But soon the Federation's people will welcome@ the 'GS' with cheers.」

0x0025E3.en: 「Then why can't you head it off in advance, knowing that?」

0x002629.en: 「Just as the Federation government of old@ foresaw Bian Zoldark's rebellion@ yet failed to prevent it...」

0x0026CB.en: 「They have circumstances of their own, it seems.」

0x00270B.en: 「You mean to foist their internal failings onto us?」

0x002748.en: 「They aren't a unified whole, after all...@ For us, it's a fine opportunity.」

0x0027B3.en: 「Turned around, it's also a fine chance to bring us down.@ So I'll take this moment to gauge@ your and Steinbeck's true intentions once more.」

0x002855.en: 「A man who isn't suspicious can't do this job.」

0x00288C.en: 「The proposal I submitted on the Steel Dragon Squadron's disposition...@ Is that why you shelved it as well?」

0x002900.en: 「They didn't vanish on purpose.@ And we need that fighting strength as insurance.」

0x002974.en: 「They may never come back, you know.」

0x0029B7.en: 「Even so, their combat record can't be ignored.@ Their existence is known even to the public.」

0x002A34.en: 「Which is why the GS must debut brilliantly@ and outdo the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ That is exactly why I took your gamble.」

0x002AF4.en: 「We have no time. Even if it means facing questions@ over a non-Federation military body, and charges@ of abusing presidential power...」

0x002B8D.en: 「We need a specialized force ready to act at once.@ To assert Earthlings' firm sovereignty over the@ sphere against the aliens - that's why we need it.」

0x002C3E.en: 「That capacity to take the good with the bad...@ and decisions pairing caution with boldness...@ that is why I serve you with all my heart.」

0x002CFB.en: 「The 'GS'... the Gaia Sabers.@ A blade that moves at the president's will, unhindered@ by army or Assembly, guarding the Earth sphere.」

0x002DAF.en: 「When the time comes...@ if the Gaia Sabers show their strength,@ the voices of doubters will be drowned out.」

0x002ECC.en: Hawaii - Federation Army North America Force, Hickam Base

0x002F38.en: 「Not a very favorable result, Hugo Medio.」

0x002F81.en: 「As unused to it as he is, with the TE engine@ acting up like that, what do you expect.」

0x002FE6.en: 「It was a test, adjustments included.@ Besides, I appointed you pilot because I@ saw promise in your ability.」

0x003064.en: 「Nice of you to say.@ Truth is, I was just a convenient piece@ that happened to fall into your lap.」

0x0030F4.en: 「I do not save those without talent or ability.@ And I promoted you to Second Lieutenant by@ special measure... gratitude would be nice.」

0x0031A5.en: 「I never asked for it.@ The reason I ended up like that in the first place...」

0x003204.en: 「Dredging that up again?@ I've explained many times that it was an accident.」

0x00326C.en: 「You expect me to accept that...!@ Because of you, the Cry Wolves...@ Foglia and my comrades...!」

0x0032FC.en: 「Accident though it was, I do feel responsible.@ That's why I saved you by special measure when the medics gave up.@ And it cost no small sum.」

0x0033BF.en: 「And this is the result. Point is, you put a collar on me@ to keep me quiet. If you'd fully healed me, I'd...」

0x003464.en: 「Your suspicion is understandable, but...@ I'd like some credit for restoring you as far as I did@ in so short a time.」

0x00350C.en: 「No one but us could have saved you.@ If you have complaints, go find another doctor.」

0x003586.en: 「No...@ If there's a doctor who can restore you further,@ I'd sooner ask you to introduce me to him.」

0x00360D.en: 「Listen.@ You owe your life to the fruits@ of the Tzentr Project.」

0x003682.en: 「So it's only natural you work@ for the project's sake.」

0x003712.en: 「...You seem to misunderstand the Tzentr Project.@ We're searching for the means to defend the Earth sphere@ from outside enemies.」

0x0037D8.en: 「One of those means is the TE Absorber Prototype Unit 6@ we gave you and your team...@ the Cerberus.」

0x003850.en: 「...Then what about the Jetzt?@ What the hell was that pseudo-Einst?」

0x0038B2.en: 「A necessary evil, you might say...@ meant to strike down beings like the <Einst>.」

0x00392C.en: 「Research comes with trial and error.@ For dragging you Cry Wolves into it,@ I am sorry.」

0x0039DD.en: 「And for not being able to reveal@ the whole of the Tzentr Project@ to you as well.」

0x003A4C.en: 「Because there's something you can't afford to have known.」

0x003A8C.en: 「Hugo... can't you cooperate willingly,@ the way Second Lieutenant Aqua does?」

0x003AFD.en: 「The Tzentr Project as it stands moves@ by the will of a certain august personage.」

0x003B77.en: 「In time, you'll come to take pride@ in having aided us.」

0x003BDF.en: 「Sorry, my head's not that rosy.@ My aim is just one thing...」

0x003C3B.en: 「I told you to do as you like.@ But whatever you do, whatever you say,@ it'll come to nothing.」

0x003CC5.en: 「A man with that much power stands above us.@ And he wishes for Earthlings to preserve the Earth sphere...@ The cause is ours.」

0x003D8B.en: 「Now is the time to endure, Hugo.@ Let us rise above old grudges, wipe away the loathsome past,@ and claim glory together.」

0x003E61.en: 「Then... would killing me set your mind at ease?」

0x003EA4.en: 「...If I could do that, I'd have done it long ago.」

0x003EF0.en: 「Yes, you're no fool.@ Which is why, for all your complaints, you don't act.@ Nor do you choose death yourself.」

0x003F95.en: (...He's right.@ There's nothing to be learned from one's own death...)

0x003FEE.en: (Complete the mission and come back alive, without fail...)

0x004028.en: (That was Captain Albero's teaching...@ If I don't survive, then Foglia and the others' deaths...)

0x0040A5.en: 「Our relationship is give and take.@ You provide us TE Absorber data...@ and I provide you the means to live.」

0x0041B5.en: 「Yes.@ Because you and your team will be heading to Japan.」

0x004218.en: 「Indeed. For a while, you will be seconded to the@ <Special Tactics Instructor Corps> at Izu Base@ to gather live data on the Cerberus.」

0x0042AD.en: (The Izu <Instructor Corps>... Major Kai Kitamura's unit.)

0x0042F5.en: 「Also, Unit 7 will be sent to Izu as soon as it rolls out.@ You'll be testing that one too.」

0x0043A3.en: 「Unlike the Cerberus,@ it's a <super robot> type TE Absorber.@ We're tuning it as a machine for your team.」

0x004438.en: 「Its name is Garmraid.@ The spec data will come with the machine.」

0x004491.en: 「...Unit 5 is Medius Locus,@ Unit 6 is Cerberus, and Unit 7 is Garmraid...」

0x004514.en: 「You gave us the Medius data for reference,@ but how many TE Absorbers are there in all?」

0x0045A0.en: 「You have no need to know that.@ Also, no one else is to pilot@ the Cerberus or the Garmraid.」

0x00462A.en: 「Not that they could. Those two are@ adjusted as your team's exclusive machines,@ so no one else can operate them.」

0x0046C9.en: 「You're saying it's fine if the other side learns@ about the Cerberus and Garmraid?」

0x004768.en: 「However, if you take any action@ that works against the project...」

0x00481D.en: (...Now is the time to endure, huh.@ On that, I can agree.)

0x004870.en: (I'll play along, Mitarl Zapad.@ For now...!)

0x004951.en: 「I'd ask what kind of machine, but...@　that's classified, isn't it?」

0x0049A4.en: 「That's right.@　If you were doing work tied to the Federation,@　you might have caught wind of it, but...」

0x004A4C.en: 「By the way, after you left Aviano Base...@　where are you now, and what are you doing?」

0x004AE8.en: 「O-oh, I see.@　Sorry for calling so casually...」

0x004B41.en: 「It's fine.@　I was hoping to see your face too.」

0x004B94.en: 「What's wrong? That look on your face.」

0x004BC2.en: 「H-hearing words like that from you, Teacher...@　it caught me a little off guard...」

0x004C5B.en: 「You were one of my brightest students...@　so having you still look up to me makes me happy.」

0x004CE4.en: 「Th-thank you!@　Honestly, I thought reaching out to you@　might be a bother...」

0x004DB8.en: 「By the way, Aqua...@　you don't regret the path you chose, do you?」

0x004E1A.en: 「No.@　Though my father still doesn't understand it...」

0x004E73.en: 「If you hadn't run off, you could have chosen@　a different, more glamorous way to live.」

0x004EED.en: 「Like I said before, I hate being a caged bird.@　I want to prove myself by my own strength.」

0x004F8C.en: 「Well then, Teacher... it's about time for me to go.」

0x004FCF.en: 「Aqua... one last thing.@　What a pilot needs is the ability to stay calm,@　analyze any situation, and handle anything.」

0x005098.en: 「And without it, you die... right?@　I remember. Those words.」

0x005113.en: 「I won't be able to reach you for a while, but...@　I hope we meet again somewhere.」

0x00518A.en: 「Yes... I'll be looking forward to it.」

0x00520D.en: 「At this rate the engine's overloaded.@　I'm switching power to battery.」

0x005278.en: 「No way! A long solo run on the TE Engine,@　Hawaii to Izu within the time limit...@　those are Dr. Zapad's orders!」

0x00536F.en: 「I-I know that's my fault!@　Now I can't face Major Kai...」

0x005420.en: 「Yeah, I met him once at Aviano Base.@　Got his autograph. It's in my bag.」

0x0054AF.en: (This girl... she's more of a fangirl than I'd have guessed.)

0x0054E6.en: 「'Him'... so you've met the Major too?」

0x005573.en: 「Then we might have... passed each other@　at that base without knowing it.」

0x005603.en: 「R-right!@　Any more delay and it'll hurt our evaluation!」

0x00566F.en: 「Easy for you to say, you've got a track record.@　But me, I...」

0x0056C8.en: 「If the evaluation worries you, do your job right.@　With output skirting the yellow zone,@　there's no telling when we'll sink.」

0x005773.en: 「Ugh... th-that's true, but@　I'm the navigator too. Follow my directions.」

0x0057E1.en: 「When they're more accurate than my judgment.」

0x005809.en: 「There you go again!@　What do you think I'm riding@　in this machine for?」

0x00589D.en: 「Right, right, because you're always@　defying Dr. Zapad and...」

0x0058F9.en: 「No, that's not it!@　I put up with this super embarrassing suit@　to run the TE Engine's DFC and...」

0x00599B.en: 「Yeah, just focus on the output adjustment.@　Leave the rest to me.」

0x005A3D.en: 「See, like catching an unidentified craft@　closing in, like this...」

0x005B02.en: 「That's definitely no welcome party from Izu.@　They fired first. We're returning fire, Aqua.」

0x005BAD.en: (I see... this is her first real combat.)

0x005BE4.en: 「Pull yourself together, Aqua!@　If you can't stay calm, analyze, and act,@　we're done for!」

0x005C66.en: (Th-that's right... just like Teacher Mitte taught me...!)

0x005CAC.en: 「DFC, battle mode!@　TE Engine, adjusting output...@　ngh, I can't get out of the yellow zone!」

0x005D39.en: 「A-and I have to calculate@　the enemy's movement patterns too...!」

0x005D8F.en: 「Calm down.@　Just handle the engine output.@　That's all you need to do.」

0x005DF2.en: 「I-I can pull my weight elsewhere too!」

0x005E2C.en: (At least she's not frozen up anymore... then!)

0x005EF6.en: 「Hugo, there are machines closing in on us!@　Five of them, IDs are...!」

0x005F79.en: 「Major Kai, is that the transferee's new model?」

0x005FCC.en: 「And the other one...@　same model as the one that picked a fight@　while Latooni was testing the Schnabel.」

0x00606F.en: 「We still don't have detailed data on the new@　model. Just to be safe, we should confirm it.」

0x0060FB.en: 「Right.@　...You, the blue machine! This is the Far East@　<Special Tactics Instructor Corps>, Major Kai Kitamura!」

0x00618A.en: 「State your affiliation, rank, and name at once!」

0x0061D7.en: 「What's going on...?!@　They haven't been told about us?!」

0x006239.en: (Hmph, just like Mitarl to do this.@　Didn't want us scouted out beforehand.)

0x0062A7.en: 「This is the Zentr Project,@　TE Absorber prototype unit 6, Cerberus.@　Pilot, Second Lieutenant Hugo Medio.」

0x006358.en: 「The Zentr Project...?!@　Hugo Medio, you say?!」

0x0063EB.en: 「So the transferee to our unit was you...!」

0x006437.en: (Hugo Medio... I met him at Aviano.@　He was a member of the 3rd Special Ops PT unit,@　the Kry Wolves.)

0x0064D0.en: (But that squad, in the battle with Jetzt...)

0x006547.en: 「The bio-weapon Flatfish the Hiryu Kai ran into...@　and the plan believed tied to@　the Wendigo and the Jetzt...」

0x006601.en: 「Yeah.@　I'd heard from Gilliam it was suspended, but...」

0x006676.en: 「In any case, we get through this first.@　Then you'll tell us everything, Lieutenant Hugo.」

0x006747.en: 「High heat source, rising fast from the sea! One contact!」

0x0068D9.en: 「But why is it here...?@　Don't tell me it's for the Instructor Corps too?」

0x00693B.en: 「No, Mitarl told me about unit 7, but@　the Medius...」

0x0069C2.en: 「Tch, Mitarl! @　Did you set this up again?! Who's the pilot?!」

0x006A2A.en: 「...For now, it seems@　they're handling the Cerberus well enough.」

0x006A83.en: 「Though I doubt they're drawing out its full potential...」

0x006ACC.en: 「Plenty for the Medius's first battle. And Kai@ Kitamura's Instructor Corps is here too...@ perfect to teach AI1 the terror of combat.」

0x006BBA.en: 「It can learn that sort of thing too, can't it?」

0x006BFD.en: 「There's no need to teach this child such an emotion.@　I don't know how your own child turned out, but...」

0x006C8F.en: 「Ah, I shouldn't have brought up@　the subject of children with you.」

0x006CEB.en: 「...Lieutenant Hugo, can't you make@　contact with him?」

0x006DA6.en: 「No talking it out, then! We'll force the answers out!@　All units, disable the Medius Locus!」

0x006E4B.en: 「Hugo, is this okay?!@　At this rate, the Medius will...!」

0x006E9E.en: 「I've no intention of dying here! We're going too!」

0x006EF7.en: 「Beginning data collection... the fighting's yours, Major.」

0x006F53.en: (Hugo Medio... I'll descend into the demon's path.@　To achieve my goal...!)

0x006FC4.en: (Now, Hugo...@　show me the power you've regained with the Cerberus.)

0x00701D.en: 「Who are you?!@　Why are you attacking us?!」

0x0070A8.en: 「He seems to have the power to fight the Medius.」

0x0070EE.en: 「Who do you think raised that thing?」

0x00715C.en: 「I know that without you telling me.」

0x007202.en: 「! AI1 is showing a rejection reaction...!?」

0x00727D.en: 「It felt it, didn't it. The terror of real combat.」

0x0072DC.en: 「Never mind, we'll call it here for today.@　Cramming too much in isn't good.」

0x007360.en: (Hugo... struggle against your destiny.@　Do that, and a path may open.)

0x0073E0.en: (For me, or for you, or perhaps for us both...)

0x007482.en: 「Of course...@　it doesn't carry a TE Engine,@　so its output is stable...」

0x00751C.en: 「That movement...@　whoever's piloting it is quite the veteran.」

0x00759A.en: Earth Federation Far East Forces, Izu Base

0x007637.en: 「I know. I'll ask Mitarl about it later.」

0x00767A.en: 「Second Lieutenant Hugo Medio,@　Second Lieutenant Aqua Centrum... welcome to Izu Base.」

0x0076EE.en: 「It's been a while, Lieutenant Lamia Loveless.@　Um... do you remember me?」

0x007774.en: 「Yes...@　at Aviano, I signed an autograph with Major Kai.」

0x0077CA.en: 「Wow, you remembered!@　I'm thrilled! I still treasure it!」

0x007838.en: 「Then let me introduce the members of the@　<Special Tactics Instructor Corps>.」

0x00790E.en: (Th-they're young... I'd heard as much, but...@　Major Kai aside, Hugo's younger than me too...@　I'm raising the average age here.)

0x0079C2.en: 「U-um... Lieutenant Aqua...@　may I ask you one thing?」

0x007AA5.en: 「The top half aside, the bottom's basically a swimsuit...@　I don't know where to look...」

0x007B1F.en: 「When piloting the Cerberus, I have to bare some skin@　to perform DFC...@　Direct Feeling Control.」

0x007BCD.en: 「For the record, I don't wear this@　DFC suit all the time.@　Only when I'm aboard the machine.」

0x007C66.en: 「D-don't tell me Lieutenant Hugo does too...?!」

0x007CA6.en: 「No, I handle piloting and combat.@　This isn't some samba carnival. A man and woman@　dressed like that would just be a laughingstock.」

0x007D4E.en: 「I-I don't wear this outfit@　because I like it either!」

0x007DA7.en: 「But you've gotten a bit used to it, haven't you?」

0x007DDB.en: 「Right, right, I could hop straight into a bath like this...」

0x007E77.en: (Never thought I'd end up wearing something@　even more revealing than Lieutenant Lamia's...)

0x007F00.en: 「...Major Kai has issued a summons.@　I'll show you to his office.」

0x007F69.en: （...Hugo Medio...@　This reading... could it be that he's...）

0x007FC5.en: 「Ah... excuse me.@　I'd like to change into my uniform. Could you give me a moment?」

0x008030.en: 「Understood. Seolla, show the lieutenant to the changing room.」

0x0080BE.en: 「Yes. It's the collective term for the humanoid mobile weapons@　developed under the Zentr Project, powered by@　Terminus Energy.」

0x008169.en: 「Give me the rundown.@　It's classified, so we've been told@　next to nothing on our end.」

0x0081ED.en: 「Even today, all we were told was that new machines were coming@　from Hickam and that we should go pick them up.」

0x008261.en: 「Understood. First, Terminus Energy is an energy source@　discovered by Dr. Mitarl Zapad of@　the Zentr Project...」

0x008321.en: 「Besides the four known forces - gravity, electromagnetism, strong and weak interactions - it was predicted to exist.」

0x0083B9.en: 「In theory it exists everywhere, but...@　collecting and applying it was said to be extremely difficult.」

0x008448.en: 「What made that possible is the TE Engine@　mounted in Cerberus...@　the Terminus Energy Engine.」

0x008502.en: 「It's far from complete, though.@　At this point it's still no more than a prototype.」

0x008567.en: 「Because of that, the output is unstable. We supplement it with electricity, so I must board in a DFC suit to control the engine output.」

0x008640.en: 「If that TE Engine were ever perfected...@　then in theory, a TE Absorber's operating time@　would be infinite. Correct?」

0x008723.en: 「That's the fifth TE Absorber prototype,@　developed alongside Cerberus, but@　it has no TE Engine installed.」

0x0087D4.en: 「Instead, its frame and armor@　use Razmnanium.」

0x00885B.en: 「Razmnanium is a new material Dr. Zapad developed,@　like the TE Engine...」

0x0088CF.en: 「In a word,@　it's a metal with an autonomous self-repair function.」

0x008925.en: 「...Just like <Machine Cells>.@　Is there some connection?」

0x00897D.en: 「No, I've heard nothing to that effect, but...」

0x0089C0.en: 「An infinite power source, a self-repairing material... So Zentr's goal is a maintenance-free mobile weapon?」

0x008AA2.en: 「A woman named Donna Gallagher, who was once involved@　with the Zentr Project, was working on the same concept@　to develop unmanned units...」

0x008B50.en: 「She said she was developing autonomous mass-production@　mobile weapons a decade ahead of their time.」

0x008BC4.en: 「I've heard the early prototypes were unmanned, but...@　we don't have a full grasp@　of the project.」

0x008C6C.en: 「I only just recently learned the seventh prototype even exists...」

0x008CB8.en: 「Then do you have any idea why@　Medius Locus attacked us?」

0x008D26.en: 「No, none... This is only my guess,@　but there's a chance it was@　seized by someone.」

0x008D9B.en: 「Assuming that's true - why did it show up there,@　targeting us... no, targeting you?」

0x008E15.en: 「...I don't know.@　It was an unforeseen situation for us as well.@　I'll query Dr. Zapad later and report to the Major.」

0x008EB4.en: 「Understood.@　Then, including the No. 7 unit being brought in later,@　I approve your assignment here.」

0x008F2C.en: 「Thank you.@　It'll only be for a while, but we're in your care.」

0x008F8E.en: 「Actually, there are transferees besides you.@　They're due to arrive the day after tomorrow.@　I trust you'll all get along with my people.」

0x009040.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo, I need a word with you.@　Lamia and Aqua, step out.」

0x0090E0.en: 「...I had something I wanted to@　discuss with you as well, Major Kai.」

0x009130.en: 「I figured.@　I caught wind of what happened to the Cry Wolves@　after that, through the grapevine...」

0x00919F.en: 「In the battle with Yetzt, the only survivors@　were myself and Major Albero Est...」

0x00921C.en: 「I've seen your physical data...@　The reason it turned out that way is, as I suspected...」

0x009287.en: 「About that matter... I'd like it kept@　from Lieutenant Aqua and the others.」

0x0092FB.en: 「Don't want to worry them needlessly?@　Lamia's probably already noticed.」

0x009363.en: 「Even so...@　to me, it's a past I'd rather forget.@　And I'm bound by confidentiality as well.」

0x0093E7.en: 「...I don't have a good impression of@　the Zentr Project. With or without@　the Medius incident.」

0x00948F.en: 「I'm aware of that, but...@　I haven't been told the truth@　behind the Zentr Project either.」

0x009537.en: 「Still... I have my doubts about that project.@　I'd just like you to keep@　that much in mind, Major.」

0x0095EE.en: 「But you can't help me get to the truth of it?」

0x00965C.en: （So someone's got a hold over him, is that it...）

0x00969C.en: 「All right.@　I'll make sure Lamia keeps quiet about your body too.」

0x009720.en: 「One last question.@　Major Albero Est... where is he now?」

0x009806.en: 「I'm your partner, after all. I was waiting.@　Besides, I've got something to ask Dr. Zapad too.」

0x0098B1.en: 「...Hey, what did you and Major Kai talk about?」

0x00991C.en: 「Oh, is that so.@　Well, I figured that'd be your answer.」

0x00997C.en: 「Medius was hijacked...@　Is that really true!?」

0x0099CF.en: 「Yes, while it was in transit to us.」

0x0099FD.en: 「That was being handled in secret, wasn't it?@　How did it leak to the outside?」

0x009A59.en: 「Unknown. We're investigating the culprit,@　considering the possibility of an informant, but...@　so far there are no promising leads.」

0x009B2F.en: 「And what would I gain by doing that?@　Losing Medius Locus means@　the project grinds to a halt.」

0x009BDD.en: 「In any case, if Medius appeared over there...@　the culprit may be after Cerberus too.@　Take every precaution.」

0x009CA0.en: 「Before that - isn't Garmraid, the No. 7 unit being shipped to us, in danger?」

0x009D1A.en: 「In light of this incident,@　I've requested a heavy escort from the Federation Army.」

0x009D70.en: 「Huh... and yet you didn't bother to properly@ brief the instructor corps about us.」

0x009DD5.en: 「I sent advance notice. If word still@　hasn't reached them regardless...@　perhaps the problem lies on Izu's end?」

0x009E8D.en: 「...Well then, I expect good things from your work.@　May we get better operational data@　out of Cerberus and Garmraid. That is all.」

0x009F38.en: （For now... all I can do is watch how he plays it...）
